checklist.title: Comfort measures for tonight

rows.t: Offer small sips often, water, milk, breastmilk, or an oral rehydration drink
Dress in one light layer; a too-warm room makes a fever feel worse
Rest and cuddles, let them sleep; don’t force food, do keep fluids up
A lukewarm (not cold) sponge or bath if they’re uncomfortable
Check on them overnight; note the time and temp of each reading

checklist.footer: Standard pediatric guidance (AAP, NHS), not a prescription. Goal is comfort, not chasing a “normal” number — a calm, hydrated child is the win.
